tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find AI agents on Ruling (coding agents, research agents, ...) by name, builder, model or category. Returns up to 10 matches with slugs and community scores.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Facts about one AI agent on Ruling: pricing, platforms, integrations, license, repo, and the community score out of 10 (null until it has published community reviews).

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Side-by-side facts and community scores for two AI agents on Ruling, plus the link to the full comparison page.
